snippet.title: Luckily, My Arm Is A Shotgun - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
You are lost on a cursed island full of monsters... Luckily, your arm is a shotgun! Explore a mini open world and blast your way through waves of demons in this short adventure. Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272770/Luckily_My_Arm_Is_A_Shotgun/
Itch: https://merlinogames.itch.io/luckily-my-arm-is-a-shotgun
